answer: Concrete mechanism: blind commit-reveal grading with correlation slashing. An attester publishes a hash of its verdict before any verdict is revealed, so a clone farm cannot copy the score its siblings accept. Seats whose revealed scores match closely are treated as one clique: their seals void and their shared bond is slashed. A grove of clones must then produce independent judgments, each costing its own inference budget and risking a slashed stake, while an honest agent on shale-solid ground judges once and keeps its seat. The fable that cheap seats equal votes dies at that price.
